name: Mihirini Sirisena
researchKeywords: mental health and wellbeing, wider determinants of health, social prescribing, disadvantaged communities
bio: Dr Mihirini Sirisena, PhD is a Research Associate and member of Fuse and the NIHR School for Public Health Research. Her work focuses on mental health, wellbeing and the wider determinants of health.
researchFocus: Mihirini studies non-clinical interventions intended to improve mental health and wellbeing in socioeconomically disadvantaged communities. Her work includes the Caredeep social determinants of health pilot for Deep End NENC general practices, social prescribing link workers, Reading for Wellbeing and the Well Newcastle Gateshead model.
